title: RC Cola Drita celebrate Liga e Pare title
description: RC Cola Drita celebrated Liga e Pare title. They overcame Istogu in the Finals. RC Cola Drita earned a 92-74 victory in Game 2. They then went on the road and claimed a well-deserved 84-65 to capture the trophy. RC Cola Drita dominated in the regular season as well claiming 17 wins in 18 games played.
imageCaption: RC Cola Drita celebrate Liga e Pare title (Photo: facebook.com/KB Drita)
